info.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Queensland Anonymous Locale 1
info.description:
Severe thunderstorms in the warning area have temporarily eased. However, the redevelopment of severe thunderstorms remains possible. The situation is being closely monitored and further detailed warnings will be issued as necessary.
106 km/h wind gust was recorded at Wellcamp Airport at 4:07 pm 3 to 4 cm hail was observed around Miles around 3 pm
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Never drive, walk, play or ride through floodwater. It is dangerous. * Stay away from storm water drains. * Stay away from fallen powerlines. * Drive slowly and never drive through floodwaters. If the road is flooded or damaged, go another way. * For storm help, call the SES on 132 500 or download the free SES Assistance QLD app.
